body.name: \(\Omega_{\pi_0}^{\mathrm{CA}}\)
body.construction: For fixed \(p\ge2\), \(m\ge2\), and \(\pi_0\in\mathfrak S_V\), define \(\Omega_{\pi_0}^{\mathrm{CA}}=\{\theta=((B^{(a)})_{a\in M},(\Gamma_i)_{i\in V}):B^{(a)}[\pi_0(k),\pi_0(j)]=0\text{ whenever }j\ge k,\ \Gamma_i\in\mathbb S_{++}^{m}\text{ for every }a\in M,i\in V\}\). Give this set the relative Euclidean topology on the free strictly \(\pi_0\)-lower-triangular coefficients and symmetric covariance entries. Each \(\theta\) induces \(\Sigma_\theta^{ab}=(I_p-B^{(a)})^{-1}\operatorname{diag}_{i\in V}(\Gamma_i[a,b])(I_p-B^{(b)})^{-\mathsf T}\), hence a centered component-aligned Gaussian law.
